failure_summary.description: A search was not saved, or a follow-up ignored a suitable cached base and failed to apply only the new constraint.
The agent asked for missing dates but omitted a requested restaurant search whose required city was already known.
The agent put a return date on the outbound flight, passed an unsupported traveler-count argument, and omitted separate saved legs.
Accepted follow-ups triggered unrelated cache reads or proximity work, or used a normalized rather than exact category.

patch.reasoning: The recurring failures are already covered by explicit rules in the skill: save every result, apply cache deltas, handle each domain's required inputs independently, search round-trip legs separately without traveler counts, preserve exact categories, and use proximity tools only when requested. Adding overlapping guidance would duplicate existing content rather than patch a skill gap.
